description:
Get trade history for a Stacks wallet address. Returns recent buy/sell events with token, pool, and USD value details. Powered by the Tenero API (api.tenero.io). No authentication required.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

chain.description: Chain to query: stacks, spark, or sportsfun (default: stacks)

limit.description: Maximum number of trades to return (default: 20, max: 100)

name: tenero_wallet_trades
